name: Phosphatosaurus
sum: Phosphatosaurus is a large, blunt-toothed dyrosaurid crocodylomorph from Paleogene phosphate deposits of North Africa.
wsnote: A large dyrosaurid with a skull more than 1 m long (English Wikipedia, rev. 1380808813); no body-length estimate.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted; named from the phosphate deposits of southern Tunisia by Bergounioux (1955).
material: Tunisian specimens of P. gavialoides; further remains from Mali and Niger (the Niger specimen not identified to species) are reported in the literature.
biology: A long-snouted marine crocodylomorph with blunt teeth and a spoon-shaped snout tip; the sources consulted give no more on diet.
author: Bergounioux 1955
